fact: The Reporter Ethiopia says a new regulation requires Ethio Telecom and Safaricom to contribute 1.5% of revenue to the Universal Access Fund, about 2.5 billion Birr a year, to bridge the digital divide.

The World Bank says the Ethiopia Digital Foundations Project will continue to focus on expanding rural connectivity, and that JICA was planning to support the Universal Service Fund managed by the Ethiopian Communications Authority.

Minister Frehiwot Tamru directed the Ethiopian Communications Authority to work with operators and regional administrations to expand connectivity in rural and underserved communities, with measurable targets expected, per the Ministry of Innovation and Technology.
